verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no free plan or its limits. The only first-party free access is the no-login hosted MCP Inspector, which lets a developer connect to and test MCP servers and execute tools from the browser without paying. A community report says a credit card was needed for rebuild/release to work, and that this was not documented, so hosting and deployment may not be usable for free. missing for 10: a documented free tier on the pricing page with stated limits, free hosting or Gateway usage for prototyping, and independent confirmation that prototyping works without payment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype my agent's tool connections on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: Inspect any MCP server directly from your browser. No login required.
Glama's hosted inspector connects to remote Streamable HTTP and SSE endpoints so you can inspect available capabilities and test requests interactively
